_meta.description: Domain-specific field-definition schema for metadata from scientific documents in the photon and neutron (PaN) science domain. Extends the generic core schema with PaN-specific fields that are plausibly extractable from scientific publications. [variant: instructions removed by scripts/strip_instructions.py]
design_principles: Follows the DAPHNE4NFDI classification for field selection where appropriate for publication-extractable metadata.
Bibliographic and document-structure fields already covered by the generic schema are not repeated.
Constraints are used only where they improve normalization without harming extraction quality.
Most fields remain unconstrained to preserve robustness for LLM-based extraction.
The schema defines target metadata fields only; response formatting and provenance are handled separately.

facilities.description: Named facilities where experimental measurements reported in the document were performed.

name.description: Facility name as stated in the document.

samples.description: Samples studied through experimental measurements reported or reanalyzed in the document. A sample entry can represent a single specimen or a measured group when only the group is identified by the document.

sample_name.description: Name, label, or concise identifying phrase for the sample.

sample_description.description: Short free-text description of sample-defining details not captured by other sample fields.

chemical_composition.description: Chemical composition or chemical identifier stated for the sample.

sample_state.description: Physical state or form of the sample as written in the document.

sample_mass.description: Mass of the sample as stated in the document, including value and unit.

supplier_or_creator.description: Short statement of where the sample came from, if explicitly stated in the document.

datasets.description: Experimental measurement datasets reported or reanalyzed in the document, grouped by experimental technique and distinct measurement campaign rather than by downstream analysis outputs.

id.description: Stable local dataset identifier for this dataset.

dataset_name.description: Short label identifying this dataset within the document.

sample_refs.description: References to sample identifiers in the samples list for samples measured in this dataset.

facility_refs.description: References to facility identifiers in the facilities list for facilities used in this dataset.

dataset_description.description: Brief free-text description of what was measured in this dataset.

measurement_technique.description: The named experimental measurement technique that produced this dataset, as written in the document.

measurement_mode.description: Major variable or variables varied during this dataset.

purpose.description: Role of this dataset in the study.
